# Journal Articles

## A State-Space Approach to Modeling Tire Degradation in Formula 1 Racing

**Cole Cappello** and Andrew Hoegh\
*Journal of Sports Analytics*, 2026.\
DOI: [10.1177/22150218261446170](https://doi.org/10.1177/22150218261446170)

This paper develops a Bayesian state-space modeling framework for estimating latent tire degradation dynamics in Formula 1 racing.
